name: iphone-duo-games
title_zh: 折叠屏展开后，你的游戏 UI 还压在摄像头下面吗
tagline_zh: iPhone Duo 一折一展，游戏画面就露黑边、摇杆被摄像头挖孔压住、横竖屏切换后按钮跑到屏幕外。
tagline_en: Duo folds and unfolds, and your game shows letterboxing, joysticks under the camera cutout, buttons off-screen.
desc_en: Adapt a game to iPhone Duo — filling the screen across every device pose, orientation locking, aspect ratio versus letterboxing, keeping touch controls out of the fold, and consistent text and control sizing while resizing. Use when the project is a game or uses a game engine such as Unity, Unreal, Godot, SpriteKit or Metal.
why_zh: 不是简单拉伸，而是按姿态分别解算：比例适配、方向锁、安全区、控件与字号随尺寸连续缩放。
why_en: Not a stretch: it solves per pose — aspect fit, orientation lock, safe areas, and continuous control/text scaling so all poses.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 iPhone Duo 的折叠/展开姿态与横竖屏，不含 iPad 分屏和安卓折叠机；项目需用 Unity。
limit_en: Covers only iPhone Duo folded/unfolded poses and rotation, not iPad split view or Android foldables; needs Unity, Unreal, Godot, SpriteKit or Metal.
title_en: Make your game fit every iPhone Duo pose
